profile.headline: Cleared Software Engineer | USAF Veteran
profile.summary:
Software Developer with a robust background as a US Air Force veteran in intelligence analysis and a dynamic skill set honed in an intensive Java Full-Stack coding bootcamp. Demonstrates a strong
command over Spring Boot, Java, SQL, RESTful APIs, and Agile Methodologies, coupled with a proven track record of leading project management initiatives and enhancing team collaboration. Eager to leverage 12+ years of diverse experience and a forward-thinking approach to drive innovation and efficiency in software development or QA roles.

A little about me, I grew up in San Bernardino, California, as a devout Laker, Dodger, and Charger fan. Sports were always my outlet for my natural competitive drive, playing basketball (PG), football (CB/QB), baseball (OF), running track (100m/200m/400m/1600m relay), boxing, BJJ, and Judo. 

I joined the USAF after going to college for business, where i  had a very successful career as an all-source intelligence analyst. There I honed my analytical skills, public speaking, and ability to learn complex concepts and teach them to other analysts & operators (USAF pilots & special operations personnel). I deployed four times to the UAE, Djibouti, and South East Asia (twice), additionally, I  was given the opportunity to live in Northern California, the United Kingdom, South Korea, and Hawaii. 

I've learned a lot, met a lot of amazing people and really just want an opportunity to excel. 

Technologies:
Languages: Java 
Web: Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap
Database: SQL, Spring Data, JPA, JDBC, JPQL 
APIs: REST, JSON, Fetch, AJAX, XHR
Methodologies: TDD
Frameworks: Spring, Spring Boot, Agile, Scrum
Configuration Management: Git
Clearance: Active TS / SCI

positions.title: SmallSAT Software Developer
positions.description:
- Develop full-stack mission software for R&D small satellites, implementing ICD-driven payload integrations, telemetry processing pipelines, and operator-facing mission planning and visualization features.

- Deliver new mission capabilities across backend Java services and React-based operator interfaces, while diagnosing and resolving telemetry, integration, and system stability issues in a production satellite operations environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker Products · Linux · Java · JavaScript · Vue · MongoDB · Go (Programming Language) · Rust (Programming Language)

positions.title: Java Full-Stack Bootcamp Graduate
positions.description:
- Crafted full-stack Java applications with Spring Boot, SQL, JPA, and JavaScript
- Devised RESTful APIs and implemented Spring Data JPA Repositories
- Created front-end components using JavaScript, Angular, AJAX, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap
- Applied Test Driven Development using JUnit
- Utilized Agile/Kanban methodologies via GitHub, Zoom, Slack, Trello
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Angular · Java · Spring Framework · REST APIs · Spring Boot · SQL · Team Leadership · HTML · JSON · Time Management · Public Speaking · JavaScript · AJAX

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
- Transitioned legacy system to MicroService architecture, boosting application scalability and efficiency
- Authored high-quality Java code, ensuring seamless functionality
- Implemented RESTful APIs using JSON, enhancing data exchange processes
positions.insights: Skills: Open Source Software · Node.js · Java · Open-Source Software · REST APIs · MERN Stack · React.js · JSON · MongoDB · Time Management · Express.js

positions.title: Supervisor In Charge of Technical Operations Analysis
positions.description:
- Led project management initiatives, applying Agile methodologies to streamline workflow, enhance team collaboration, and ensure timely completion of intelligence operations.
- Intelligence representative for Site Activation Task Force (SATAF), responsible for compliance and meeting DIA security requirements
- Co-Authored intelligence reporting directive that established the standards for intelligence report writing, cutting editing time by over 25%.

positions.title: Senior Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
- Utilized advanced data analytics to support strategic decision-making, closely working with large datasets and performing complex queries.
- Developed and maintained documentation for intelligence processes.
- Directly oversaw ISR support during the 2022 G-20 Summit, utilizing national ISR collection requirements to ensure the safety of the POTUS, VPOTUS, and staff.

positions.title: Executive Assistant to the Command Chief
positions.description:
- Advised 15th Wing's senior enlisted leader in leading enlisted force of 1.8K total force Airmen across 30 units, supporting HQ PACAF
- Established an emergency operations center to handle Navy water crisis on Oahu. Rapidly set up a 24/7 ops center in less than 4 hours & distributed $366K in AF financial aid to assist affected families.

positions.title: Supervisor, Intelligence Operations
positions.description:
- Led cross-departmental efforts to improve data sharing and analysis capabilities, demonstrating effective stakeholder engagement and project leadership.
- Enhanced system security protocols and conducted regular reviews to ensure the integrity of intelligence data.

positions.title: Intelligence Analyst/Unit Security Manager
positions.description:
- Directed an intelligence team, fostering continuous learning and improvement
- Facilitated real-time rescue operation, ensuring survival of 74 personnel
- Produced and presented thousands of analytical reports and risk analysis briefings
- Informed tactical, operational, and strategic decision-making through data interpretation

positions.title: Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
- Supported U-2, Global Hawk, MC-12, MQ-1, and MQ-9s contributing to mission success and operational effectiveness.
- Influenced operational effectiveness through strategic intelligence support
- Demonstrated analytical acumen in complex mission scenarios
- Resolved operational issues, ensuring mission readiness
- Impact: Increased mission success rate
